controls.regle: Each AI system in scope (model, agent, assisted feature) is recorded in an inventory and classified according to a documented risk level (e.g. unacceptable, high risk, limited risk, minimal risk), together with the justification for that classification.
controls.verification: Request the inventory of the AI systems in scope and the risk classification of each; verify that the classification justification is documented and consistent with the system's purpose.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of AI systems with risk level and justification, dated and kept up to date.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete inventory with a justified classification for each system ; partial = partial inventory or unjustified classification ; non-compliant = no inventory and no classification
actions_audit: Request the inventory of the AI systems in scope; attach the reference.
Verify the risk classification of each system and its documented justification.
If gap: build the inventory and classify each missing system.
standards: EU AI Act (Règlement UE 2024/1689) — classification par niveau de risque
NIST AI RMF 1.0 — fonction Map (contexte et catégorisation du risque)

controls.regle: Behavioral drift of an AI system in production (performance degradation, change in the distribution of inputs, quality regression) is monitored with a documented threshold and a defined corrective action (retraining, restriction, withdrawal) when that threshold is exceeded.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of drift monitoring (metric, frequency, threshold) for each system classified above minimal risk, and the definition of the corrective action triggered when the threshold is exceeded.
controls.preuve_attendue: Drift monitoring configuration + measurement history + documented corrective action procedure.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = active monitoring with a threshold and a documented corrective action ; partial = active monitoring without a defined corrective action ; non-compliant = no drift monitoring
actions_audit: Request the drift monitoring configuration and its measurement history; attach the export.
Verify the definition of the corrective action triggered when the threshold is exceeded; document the finding.
If gap: establish the missing monitoring and corrective action.
standards: NIST AI RMF 1.0 — fonction Measure (suivi de performance et de dérive)
ISO/IEC 42001:2023 — 8.2 (évaluation continue du système de management de l'IA)

controls.regle: Effective human oversight exists over decisions with significant impact taken or assisted by an AI system: a named human can review, correct, or stop the decision, and this capability is tested periodically (not merely declared).
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a named human oversight role for each system with significant impact, and the execution of a periodic test demonstrating the actual capability to review, correct, or stop.
controls.preuve_attendue: Description of the human oversight mechanism (role, scope, mode of intervention) + report of the last test exercising that capability.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = named oversight and a conclusive exercise test less than 12 months old ; partial = named oversight without a recent test ; non-compliant = no human oversight identified
actions_audit: Request the description of the human oversight mechanism and the named role responsible for it.
Request the report of the last test exercising the review/correction/stop capability; verify its date and its conclusion.
If gap: name the oversight role and run a documented exercise test.
standards: EU AI Act (Règlement UE 2024/1689) — art. 14 (supervision humaine)
ISO/IEC 42001:2023 — Annexe A (contrôles de supervision humaine)

controls.regle: Each AI system classified above minimal risk carries an up-to-date compliance documentation sheet (purpose, training/input data, risk measures, end-user information), accessible to the designated compliance authority.
controls.verification: Request the compliance documentation sheet of each AI system above minimal risk; verify its completeness (purpose, data, risk measures, user information) and its last update date.
controls.preuve_attendue: Compliance documentation sheet per AI system, dated, accessible to the designated compliance authority.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete and up-to-date sheet (< 12 months) for each system concerned ; partial = incomplete or outdated sheet ; non-compliant = no compliance sheet
actions_audit: Request the compliance documentation sheet of each AI system above minimal risk; attach the documents.
Verify the completeness and the freshness (< 12 months) of each sheet; document the finding.
If gap: produce or update the missing or outdated sheets.
standards: EU AI Act (Règlement UE 2024/1689) — art. 11 et art. 53 (documentation technique)
